basic_profile.bio: A curious wanderer from Westchester, NY, diving into the depths of Reddit to explore diverse thoughts and communities. By day, I work as a research assistant delving into various topics, and by night, I indulge in video games and philosophical musings. In a relationship, I often find myself pondering the intricacies of human connections, much like the threads I follow. Mostly active during late evenings and weekends, I enjoy stealth games and have a budding interest in vexillology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in research, I have a knack for exploring a broad spectrum of topics ranging from philosophical queries to the nuances of regional flags. My knowledge is primarily self-taught through online resources and hands-on experience in my job, which often requires deep dives into niche subjects.
